name: twitter_cm_pro
description: Alfred AI Twitter/X Content Manager — Pro. 7+ original posts/week, competitor monitoring, auto-reply to mentions, weekly analytics report, bilingual content (ZH+EN). For crypto exchanges targeting Binance/OKX/Bitget audience. $15 USDC/day (~$450/month, vs $2000/month for a human CM).

projectDescription.description: Detailed description of your platform, products, and unique selling points vs competitors

contentTopics.description: Comma-separated content focus areas (e.g. 'spot trading,perpetuals,stablecoins,tokenized stocks,trading education,market analysis')

targetAudience.description: Detailed audience description (e.g. 'overseas Chinese-speaking crypto traders, 25-40, interested in trading platform comparison and DeFi yields')

competitors.description: Comma-separated competitors to monitor and position against (e.g. 'Binance,OKX,Bitget,Backpack,MSX')

language.description: Content language: zh (Chinese), en (English), or bilingual. Default: bilingual for Pro

postsPerWeek.description: Number of posts per week. Minimum 7. Default: 7

contentSeries.description: Optional: Define a content series (e.g. 'Web3入門教學 every Monday, Market Analysis every Wednesday')
